items.exampleEn: Our travel agent found us a cheap hotel.
items.exampleZh: 我們的旅行社專員幫我們找到便宜的旅館。

items.exampleEn: My uncle became a citizen of this country last year.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年成為這個國家的公民。

items.exampleEn: My cat loves freedom, so I let her go outside.
items.exampleZh: 我的貓喜歡自由，所以我讓牠到外面去。

items.exampleEn: The guard checked our bags at the door.
items.exampleZh: 警衛在門口檢查了我們的包包。

items.exampleEn: This TV show is about a murder on a train.
items.exampleZh: 這部影集在講一起火車上的謀殺案。

items.exampleEn: There are seven people on the committee.
This door is only for emergencies.
items.exampleZh: 這扇門只在緊急情況時使用。

items.exampleEn: Monkeys at this park often steal food from visitors.
items.exampleZh: 這座公園的猴子常常偷遊客的食物。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful. Someone might steal your bag.
items.sentenceZh: 小心，可能會有人偷你的包包。

items.audioEn: The guard says we can't take photos in this room.
items.audioZh: 警衛說我們不能在這個房間拍照。
items.questionZh: 警衛說在這個房間不可以做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: In an emergency, call this number.
items.sentenceZh: 遇到緊急情況，請打這個號碼。

items.sentenceEn: Every citizen should know the law.
items.sentenceZh: 每個公民都應該了解法律。

items.stemEn: The ____ will meet on Friday to plan the school trip.
items.stemZh: 委員會星期五要開會規劃校外教學。

items.stemEn: My grandmother loves ____ mysteries. She always knows who did it.
items.stemZh: 我奶奶很愛看謀殺推理故事，她總是猜得到兇手是誰。

items.passageEn: Our school has a reading club. This month, the club committee chose a mystery. In the story, someone steals a famous painting from a museum. A smart agent works with the museum guard to find the thief. In the end, the agent catches him at the back door! Our teacher also asked us, "What does freedom mean for a citizen?" We talked about it for an hour.
items.passageZh: 我們學校有一個讀書會。這個月，讀書會的委員會選了一本推理小說。故事裡，有人從博物館偷走一幅有名的畫。一位聰明的探員和博物館的警衛合作找小偷。最後，探員在後門抓到了他！老師還問我們：「對一個公民來說，自由代表什麼？」我們討論了一個小時。

questions.questionZh: 最後探員在哪裡抓到小偷？

rubricZh: 「偷」用 steal，時態配合句意（例如 stole、has stolen）

items.promptZh: 上大學以後，我有了更多自由。
referenceEn: After I started university, I had more freedom.
I had more freedom after I went to university.
rubricZh: 用 freedom 表示「自由」（例如 more freedom）
過去的事用過去式（例如 had）；寫 have more freedom 也正確
「上大學」可寫，例如 started university、went to university、went to college 等
